description: This file is a shell script used for testing various output formats and behaviors of the 'git fetch' command in a Git repository, including different output formats (aligned, compact, porcelain), error handling, multiple remotes, HEAD handling, object IDs, and forced updates.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed. Sets up the test environment, runs commands, and verifies output against expected results.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions to be executed after the test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the preceding command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the given output or file is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within the output to verify the presence or absence of specific strings.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
